name: create_skill
description: Stage a new learned skill for a recurring kind of problem that no existing skill covers. Cite the supporting observations.

name.description: A lowercase slug (letters, digits, single hyphens), at most 64 characters.

description.description: One line, at most 200 characters: when to use it.

body.description: Markdown without front matter, at most 8000 characters: conditions, steps, pitfalls.

category.description: Optional lowercase slug, at most 32 characters.
